# L0′ — Archetypal-Numerical

**MEF lens `L0′`** · Square A — Articulation `[0 + 5]`: silence ⇄ speech, number ⇄ word · Night face · index `#0′` · tonic `C♯` · ground-pair **Play** (Power-led) · twin: [L0 — Quaternal](L0-quaternal.md)

*Root:* Jung–Pauli psychoid numbers · *Element:* Aether · *Möbius:* `L0′ → L5`

The same Truth/Play rotation as `L0`, grounded on the Power-face: freedom read not as open question but as the qualitative integers — number as archetypal rhythm. The Name hexad (Truth→Image) stands behind as the articulable skeleton the numbers measure.

## Sublens

The six inner sublenses, each tagged with its rotated `Name[note]` / `Power[note]` (chromatic-basis note-tags):

- **L0.0′ — One/Unity** (`Play[C♯]` / `Truth[C]`) — the monad, primordial wholeness, the Self; source of all number.

- **L0.1′ — Two/Duality** (`Need[D♯]` / `Mind[D]`) — polarity, reflection, the subject–object split.

- **L0.2′ — Three/Triad** (`Sacrifice[F]` / `Word[E]`) — mediation, the "third thing," the start of succession.

- **L0.3′ — Four/Quaternity** (`Decision[G]` / `Logos[F♯]`) — completeness, the mandala, the torus's four edges.

- **L0.4′ — Five/Pentad** (`Love[A]` / `Son[G♯]`) — life-introducing asymmetry; pentagonal symmetry of living things.

- **L0.5′ — Six/Hexad** (`Work[B]` / `Image[A♯]`) — the first perfect number (`1+2+3 = 6 = 1×2×3`); the complete self-referential cycle.


## Derivation at this index

*Shares `L0`'s 8-fold and diatonic* — sounding Mind·Word·Logos·Son + Need·Sacrifice·Decision·Love; anchors Truth, Image, Play, Work; diatonic Truth–Mind–Word · Sacrifice–Decision–Love–Work.

*Reading:* grounded on Play, the field is heard as the integers' qualitative dance rather than as inquiry — the implicate floor of both speech (`L5`) and question (`L0`).
